facts.text: "Chuck, eat your stew while it is hot. After supper we find out how a patient walks out of a locked room."
facts.why: Teddy never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Teddy Daniels, so it reads as a film line. His famous last line is about the monster and the good man.
facts.fix: Which would be worse? To live as a monster, or to die as a good man?

fix_note.text: To live as a monster, or to die as a good man?

facts.text: a proper staff dinner, cut off by the storm
facts.why: The transcript only has Cawley saying he will gather staff in the common room after dinner, with the hurricane building. No dinner scene is cut off by the storm, so the note now says only what the film shows.
facts.fix: the staff dinner on the island, as the hurricane closes in

vibe.verdict: The hospital canteen works and the No. 67 voucher is a clever nod, but the dishes and notes stay safe for a film this twisty.
